claim: A bundle of EW-EFT observables claimed under-exploited at HL-LHC: interference-resurrection azimuthal angles for aTGC, polarisation/spin-correlation asymmetries for aQGC in ssWW, universal-SMEFT W,Y from NC+CC Drell-Yan, triboson dim-6/8 SMEFT, gauge-invariant dim-8 nTGC angular observables, gluonic dim-8 QGCs (gg->Zgamma/gammagamma), and HEFT-vs-SMEFT VBF HH/HHH.
surviving_gap: Most sub-ideas are already done by CMS/ATLAS. Small residual gaps remain: (i) a decay-plane azimuthal interference-resurrection fit in boosted semileptonic WV (l nu J), where only standard-parametrisation aTGC fits were found; (ii) an experimental interpretation of high-mass gamma-gamma / Z gamma spectra in terms of gluonic dim-8 QGC operators, which is recast-level (pheno 2112.06729 already uses ATLAS data; HL-LHC projection in 2512.04336); (iii) a joint NC+CC Drell-Yan universal W,Y fit with dim-8 terms; (iv) dim-8 nTGC from ZZ->4l decay angles combined with Z gamma. None is a strong standalone HL-LHC analysis.

parts.reason: CMS W gamma 2111.13948 uses the lepton azimuthal decay angle phi explicitly as 'interference resurrection' for O_3W (Abstract; Sec.2). ATLAS WZ 2507.03500 uses phi*_W, phi*_Z decay angles to revive interference for CP-odd operators (EFT section, txt ~l.1076, 1591). ATLAS WZ CP-sensitive observables are summarised in proceedings 2601.17461. Residual: boosted l nu qq.

parts.part: S060 polarisation/spin-correlation asymmetries for aQGC in ssWW/WZ
parts.reason: Proposal 2606.06436 finds sensitivity only 'comparable' to the m_T(WW) tail (Abstract). Polarised ssWW is already measured (CMS 2009.09429, ATLAS 2503.11317), as is WZjj-EW (ATLAS 2607.20246). aQGC from ssWW/WZ is in the ATLAS combination 2603.18630. Two neutrinos prevent rest-frame reconstruction. CMS HL-LHC VBS projection: INSPIRE 1488789.

parts.verdict: DIES (NC and CC separately) / NARROWED (joint + dim-8)
parts.reason: CMS-PAS-EXO-25-001 (INSPIRE 3181329) gives W and Y limits from high-mass ee/mumu, 207 fb-1 at 13+13.6 TeV. CMS 2202.06075 constrains the W parameter from l+MET. A joint NC+CC fit with dim-8 terms was not found.

aQGC limits from ATLAS WWgamma 2509.14070, CMS WZgamma 2503.21977, CMS W/Z gamma gamma 2105.12780 (scout), ATLAS VVZ 2412.15123, ATLAS QGC combination 2603.18630 (includes a triboson input). Residual: dim-6 triboson SMEFT global interpretation; rates are low.

ATLAS-CONF-2025-001 (INSPIRE 2909586) gives SU(2)xU(1) gauge-invariant nTGC limits from Z(ll)gamma. CMS 2512.08582 constrains dim-8 nTGC in a recent EFT framework, which it describes as 'for the first time'. CMS Z(nunu)gamma 2601.14102 also exists.

No CMS/ATLAS interpretation found. Pheno already recasts ATLAS data (2112.06729 abstract) and gives HL-LHC reach (2512.04336 abstract). The signal is a high-mass tail shared with nonresonant diphoton/contact-interaction searches.

parts.part: S070 HEFT vs SMEFT in VBF HH/HHH
parts.reason: kappa_2V is measured (CMS 2205.06667). HEFT interpretations exist: ATLAS 2069569, ATLAS 2970397, CMS combination 2510.07527. ATLAS HL-LHC boosted VBF HH 4b projection: INSPIRE 2898243. ATLAS W+-W+-Hjj probes WWHH (2609.25153). The VBF HHH rate is far below the ggF HHH SM rate (0.079 fb at 13 TeV, 2411.02040).

hl_projection_docs: CMS HL-LHC ssWW/WZ VBS prospects (INSPIRE 1488789); ATLAS HL-LHC boosted VBF HH 4b (INSPIRE 2898243); ATLAS HL-LHC HH projections (INSPIRE 2898222). Pheno: 2512.04336 (gluonic QGC at HL-LHC), 2008.12978 (W,Y HL).
showstoppers: Neutrino ambiguity limits decay-plane reconstruction in WW and ssWW. In boosted semileptonic WV, quark/antiquark subjet identification is ambiguous (phi folded), which reduces the resurrection gain (UNVERIFIED magnitude). EFT validity in tails at dim-8. Triboson and VBF multi-Higgs rates are low.
notes: This bundle should not go forward as one candidate. Interference resurrection in particular is an established experimental technique: CMS has used it since 2021 in W gamma. The best remaining HL-LHC hook is the boosted semileptonic WV azimuthal analysis, which is incremental.

claim: Quantum entanglement / Bell tests (spin-density-matrix tomography) in WW, WZ, ZZ continuum production, H->ZZ*, H->WW* and tau pairs have not been measured by CMS/ATLAS and are an HL-LHC opportunity.
surviving_gap: (a) H->WW*->lvlv entanglement/CGLMP test: no CMS/ATLAS result found (pheno 2209.14033, 2605.19754), but it is a Run-2/3 analysis, not HL-LHC-specific; (b) full two-qutrit tomography + concurrence/Bell in continuum high-mass ZZ->4l (and WW) at HL-LHC: only polarisation fractions measured so far; (c) tau-pair (Z/H->tautau) entanglement tomography at LHC: pheno only (2504.01496). H->ZZ* entanglement is done (ATLAS 4.7 sigma; CMS density matrix). WZ entanglement is theoretically disfavoured as demonstrable (2601.09540).

parts.reason: ATLAS 2603.26463 (separable hypothesis disfavoured at 4.7 sigma, exp 4.9); CMS-PAS-HIG-25-011 (INSPIRE 3087935) measures polarization density matrix in H->ZZ. HL-LHC is only a precision update (ATLAS conclusions).
No CMS/ATLAS measurement found; 2209.14033 claims Run-2 sensitivity using already-measured m_ll; showstopper: two neutrinos, spin-0 SM entanglement guaranteed (QM test, weak BSM leverage)

ATLAS joint-polarisation WZ (2211.09435), ZZ longitudinal (2310.04350), WZ energy dependence (2402.16365), WZjj-EW (2607.20246), CMS WZ angles (2110.11231) cover partial density-matrix information; full tomography/concurrence not done. WZ entanglement not demonstrable in realistic regimes per 2601.09540 Conclusions; Bell violation in WW/ZZ needs m_VV>900 GeV (2302.00683 abstract) -> rate-limited, HL-LHC ZZ->4l high-mass is the only plausible slice.

Pheno at LHC 2504.01496 (ML neutrino reconstruction); CMS/ATLAS H->tautau CP (2110.04836, 2212.05833, CMS 13.6 TeV INSPIRE 3138184) already exploit transverse tau spin correlations (one-observable-not-another). Showstopper: two-fold/neutrino ambiguity, tau trigger thresholds.

claim: Energy-correlator (EEC/E3C) observables on boosted top/W jets (top mass), EEC 'bump hunts inside jets' for light hadrophilic resonances, and QCD-instanton multi-jet searches are untested by CMS/ATLAS and suited to HL-LHC.
surviving_gap: Only the top/W-jet E3C measurement (m_t/m_W standard-candle method of 2311.14389/2407.12900) survives as an experimental gap: no CMS/ATLAS measurement found (only a thesis-level feasibility, INSPIRE 2853221). It is a precision measurement doable with Run 2/3, not HL-LHC-specific. The EEC bump hunt is an alternative observable for the parameter space already searched by CMS low-mass Z'->qq ISR-boosted searches (claimed only 'competitive'). The QCD-instanton part is anti-HL: the signal is low-mass and soft and needs low-pileup runs.

parts.part: E3C/EEC on boosted top & W jets (top mass)
parts.reason: No CMS/ATLAS measurement found; closest are the ATLAS Lund plane in top/W jets (2407.10879), CMS EEC in inclusive jets (2402.13864), and CMS boosted-top jet-mass m_t (1911.03800, 2211.01456). Pheno feasibility already done (2311.14389 incl. HL-LHC statistics, 2407.12900, 2405.20001); thesis 2853221. Gap type: proposed-not-searched, measurement.

parts.part: EEC bump hunt inside jets (light hadrophilic Z')
parts.reason: 2605.28934 recasts CMS low-mass qq search and finds sensitivity only 'competitive' (abstract; Fig.4 text). Same Z' parameter space is searched by CMS 1909.04114, 2603.21965 (50-300 GeV, ParticleNet), 1905.10331 (ISR photon). Signal ECs at particle level; detector granularity/unfolding may degrade (2605.28934 p.~3). Residual: a different observable/systematics profile, plus SM W/Z in EEC as a benchmark.

Signal sits at low instanton mass (20-60 GeV, 2104.01861 abstract) where pileup kills it; proposals require low-luminosity runs (2104.01861); 2012.09120 Sec.5.3 already sets a recast limit from ATLAS min-bias data; CMS low-PU event-shape measurement 2505.17850 is explicitly a reference for future instanton searches (Sec.1, lines ~64-69, 147). High-mass instantons are 'highly suppressed' (2012.09120 Sec.4). Not an HL-LHC (200 PU) analysis.

showstoppers: EEC top mass: constituent/track-level angular observable at 200 PU needs charged-track or PUPPI-type mitigation; non-perturbative and NLO theory (JEEEC at NLO is an open problem per 2201.08393 outlook) limit interpretation. claim: Triple/quadruple Higgs production beyond the 6b final state (bbbb tautau, bbbb WW, 4b gamma gamma, multilepton, resonant X->SH->HHH, 8b HHHH, quartic coupling) is not covered by CMS/ATLAS.
surviving_gap: Only non-6b, non-4b2gamma HHH channels (chiefly 4b+tautau, possibly 4b+multilepton/WW) and a multi-channel HHH (6b+4b2gamma+4btautau) combination with an HL-LHC projection survive; no CMS/ATLAS result found for these. 8b HHHH has only phenomenology (2608.16998) and is SM-rate-dead; only meaningful as resonant S->hhhh / h3->h2h2 cascades. Gap type: searched-limited-regime. The 6b (non-resonant + resonant TRSM cascades), 4b2gamma, kappa3/kappa4 constraints and 6b HL-LHC projection are already done.
